data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Allrecipes, then Wikipedia, then Notes) and uses the right note template. It lists only dish_name as a parameter even though servings varies and is used in the note. It also never says to set the servings on the recipe page, and it leaves out the "New note" click and the Enter keypress, so an automation would have to guess at those.
